Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></p> <p>The <strong>Physical AI Engineering Team</strong> at <strong>CoreWeave</strong> is building the software and infrastructure that enables demanding AI, simulation, robotics, and engineering workloads to run reliably at scale.</p> <p>As these workloads become more complex, the challenge is no longer simply providing compute. We need to make heterogeneous workloads easier to execute, observe, reproduce, and move across different systems without hiding the capabilities or semantics of the infrastructure underneath them.</p> <p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>We’re seeking a <strong>Staff Software Engineer, Runtime Systems</strong> to help design and build this layer.</p> <p>This is a hands-on systems engineering role at the intersection of <strong>distributed systems, runtimes, workflow execution, programming language concepts, and large-scale compute infrastructure</strong>.</p> <p>You’ll work on the foundations that allow complex workloads to move from an abstract description into reliable execution across systems such as Kubernetes, Argo, OSMO, and future execution environments.</p> <p>A major part of the role is deciding where abstraction is useful — and where it creates more complexity. Rather than building another universal workflow engine, you’ll help establish clear contracts between our platform and the systems that execute work, while preserving native capabilities.</p> <p>You’ll operate across architecture and implementation: defining contracts, writing production software, validating assumptions against real workloads, and working closely with platform and infrastructure teams.</p> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Runtime Systems & Architecture</strong></li> <li>Design and build runtime components for complex AI, simulation, and engineering workloads.</li> <li>Define abstractions for workloads, execution environments, dependencies, state, capabilities, and failure.</li> <li>Design interfaces between higher-level services and systems such as Kubernetes, Argo, and OSMO.</li> <li>Establish clear boundaries around which systems own state, decisions, and side effects.</li> <li>Make architectural decisions balancing simplicity, extensibility, performance, and operational reality.</li> <li><strong>Execution Models & Contracts</strong></li> <li>Define durable contracts between workload definitions, control-plane services, and execution backends.</li> <li>Develop typed representations and schemas that allow workloads to be transformed safely across systems.</li> <li>Design compatibility and evolution mechanisms for those contracts.</li> <li>Build conformance and validation mechanisms that make guarantees executable rather than dependent on documentation.</li> <li>Reason deeply about retries, partial failure, idempotency, cancellation, dependencies, and uncertain outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Hands-On Systems Engineering</strong></li> <li>Write production-quality software for critical runtime and control-plane components.</li> <li>Build adapters and integrations for heterogeneous execution environments.</li> <li>Diagnose behaviour across application, orchestration, cluster, and infrastructure boundaries.</li> <li>Improve the reliability, observability, and debuggability of distributed workload execution.</li> <li>Work closely with Go, Kubernetes, and infrastructure engineers to turn architecture into production systems.</li> <li><strong>Performance & Experimentation</strong></li> <li>Develop rigorous ways to understand workload performance across large-scale GPU infrastructure.</li> <li>Design experiments that separate real performance gains from noise, warm-up effects, scheduling behaviour, and stragglers.</li> <li>Build repeatable workload and benchmark environments.</li> <li>Use evidence from real execution to challenge assumptions and guide platform development.</li> <li><strong>Technical Leadership</strong></li> <li>Lead ambiguous systems problems where the correct architecture is not yet known.</li> <li>Reduce complex problems into smaller contracts and mechanisms that can actually be implemented.</li> <li>Challenge unnecessary abstraction and simplify designs where complexity has outgrown its value.</li> <li>Influence technical direction across teams without requiring direct authority.</li> <li>Mentor engineers and contribute to technical hiring and engineering standards.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience building complex systems software, distributed infrastructure, runtimes, workflow systems, or adjacent technology.</li> <li>Deep expertise in at least one of:</li> <ul> <li>Distributed systems</li> <li>Runtime systems</li> <li>Workflow or execution engines</li> <li>Programming languages, compilers, or interpreters</li> <li>Cluster scheduling and orchestration</li> <li>High-performance or systems software</li> </ul> <li>Strong software engineering fundamentals and production coding ability.</li> <li>Experience designing APIs, protocols, schemas, or contracts between independently evolving systems.</li> <li>Strong understanding of distributed-system failure modes, state, authority, retries, concurrency, and side effects.</li> <li>Strong technical judgement around when abstraction helps and when it simply moves complexity elsewhere.</li> <li>Comfortable entering unfamiliar technical domains and building depth quickly.</li> <li>Strong communication skills and experience influencing architectural decisions across teams.</li> </ul> <p>Experience with some of the following would be valuable, but is not required:</p> <ul> <li>Go, Rust, C/C++, or Python.</li> <li>Kubernetes and containerised infrastructure.</li> <li>Argo, OSMO, Temporal, Ray, Kubeflow, or similar systems.</li> <li>GPU clusters or large-scale AI infrastructure.</li> <li>High-performance computing.</li> <li>Simulation, robotics, autonomous systems, or Physical AI.</li> <li>Programming language or compiler research.</li> <li>Performance engineering.</li> <li>Cloud infrastructure at scale.</li> <li>Platforms designed to be operated by autonomous software or AI agents.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren’t a 100% skill or experience match.</strong> Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Systems Thinker:</strong> You ask where authority lives, what guarantees actually exist, and what happens when systems fail.</li> <li><strong>Technically Deep:</strong> You want to understand how systems really behave, not just how they are supposed to behave.</li> <li><strong>Pragmatic:</strong> You value elegant engineering, but care more about whether it works for real workloads.</li> <li><strong>Evidence-Driven:</strong> You test assumptions and change direction when the evidence says you should.</li> <li><strong>Strong Technical Leader:</strong> You can form a view, challenge senior stakeholders, and bring others with you.</li> <li><strong>Commercially Aware:</strong> You understand that technical decisions need to improve customer outcomes, engineering velocity, reliability, or economics.</li> <li><strong>Ownership Mentality:</strong> You take responsibility for getting difficult systems into production.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></p> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast. We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li>Be Curious at Your Core</li> <li>Act Like an Owner</li> <li>Empower Employees</li> <li>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</li> <li>Achieve More Together</li> </ul> <p>We support entrepreneurial thinking, independent judgement, and collaboration. You’ll work alongside some of the best talent in the industry on technically difficult problems at the frontier of AI infrastructure.</p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance </li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution </li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary </li> <li>Critical Illness Cover </li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme </li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location. </em></p> <p&

Verifone has one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and is one of the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide.</p> <p>Verifone has a diverse, dynamic and fast paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in the fact that we work with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third party partners to invent and deliver innovative payments solution around the world. We strive for excellence in our products and services, and are obsessed with customer happiness. Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. Whether it’s developing the next platform of secure payment systems or searching for new ways to bring electronic payments to new markets, the team at Verifone is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners and investors. initiatives, and serve as a trusted resource for lawyers and business stakeholders.</p> <p>This is a hands-on role requiring strong organizational skills, sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced global environment.</p> <h2><span style="color: #236fa1;">Required Skills</span></h2> <p>A successful candidate will be able to:</p> <ul> <li>Manage the appointments, board and shareholder approvals, statutory filings, powers of attorney, and corporate recordkeeping.</li> <li>Liaise with corporate secretarial service providers and internal process improvements that enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the legal function.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: #236fa1;">Required Experience and Qualifications</span></h2> <p>A across multiple jurisdictions.</li> <li>Strong familiarity with corporate governance requirements and entity management practices.</li> <li>Experience reviewing and administering NDAs and other routine commercial agreements.</li> <li>Excellent organizational and project management skills.</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines with minimal supervision.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.</li> <li>High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.</li> <li>Proficiency with AI tools, Microsoft Office applications, and legal technology tools.</li> <li>Experience working in a multinational or international company with operations across Europe and other regions.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: #236fa1;">Our Commitment</span></h2> <p>Verifone is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3 id="isPasted"><strong>Company Overview</strong></h3> <p>Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.</p> <p>Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.</p> <p>At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.</p> <p>Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.</p></div><h3> </h3> <h3><strong>Group Overview</strong></h3> <p>This role sits within Platform Group area of Metrea. The Platform Group rovides the Information Technology and Information Systems ecosystem that Metrea is utilising for the day-to-day operations, communication, collaboration and information sharing across its Platform business block.</p> <h3><strong>Position Summary</strong></h3> <p>In this role, you will lead the design and operation of secure, reliable Azure platforms that enable Metrea's UK teams to build, deploy, and support mission-focused services with confidence. You will shape how we use Azure, Azure DevOps, GitHub, automation, and DevSecOps practices to improve delivery speed, platform resilience, and developer experience. </p> <p>You will be successful if you can combine hands-on engineering depth with technical leadership: solving complex platform challenges, mentoring others, and making pragmatic decisions for sensitive defence environments. </p> CI/CD pipelines for repeatable, controlled and secure software delivery.</li> <li>Develop secure deployment patterns for AI-assisted and agentic workflows, including model integrations, automated evaluation and controlled releases.</li> <li>Deploy and secure AI platform components such as model APIs, LLM workloads and MCP servers, with appropriate access controls, secrets management and data boundaries.</li> <li>Build and optimise containerised workloads using Docker and AKS, with resilient and repeatable deployment patterns.</li> <li>Implement DevSecOps practices including policy as code, vulnerability management, secrets management and software supply-chain controls.</li> <li>Establish effective monitoring, logging, alerting and service-health reporting across platforms and workloads.</li> <li>Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, networking, identity, security, pipeline and production issues affecting business-critical services.</li> <li>Advise and mentor engineers, promote effective platform practices and help teams adopt reusable, self-service tooling.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You Bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Proven experience in a senior DevOps, platform, cloud or infrastructure engineering role supporting business-critical services.</li> <li>Strong hands-on experience designing, deploying and operating Microsoft Azure environments.</li> <li>Deep experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub, including CI/CD pipelines, release controls and deployment automation.</li> <li>Proven infrastructure-as-code experience using Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates or comparable technologies.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes and AKS, including resilient and automated deployment patterns.</li> <li>Experience implementing DevSecOps controls across infrastructure, pipelines and the software supply chain.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building AI-assisted or agentic development workflows, with exposure to model APIs, LLM deployments or MCP.</li> <li>Strong troubleshooting capability across cloud infrastructure, networking, identity, observability and software delivery.</li> <li>Ability to influence technical direction, mentor engineers and work effectively across software, platform, security and support teams.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>Desirable Experience</strong></h3> <h3> </h3> <ul> <li>Deploying or operating locally hosted LLMs or GPU-based model-serving infrastructure.</li> <li>Securing MCP servers, agent permissions and access to sensitive tools or data.</li> <li>Backstage or another internal developer platform, including reusable templates and self-service workflows.</li> <li>Experience in defence, government or another regulated environment.</li> </ul> <p> </p>  </li> <li>Free lunch on office days  </li> <li>Enhanced Parental Leave  </li> <li>30 days annual PTO plus b/h  </li> <li>Bonus Scheme  </li> <li>Personal development opportunities </li> </ul> Employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.  </p> <h3><strong>Position Type and Expected Hours of Work</strong></h3> <p>This is a full-time non-exempt position with typical working hours of Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Hours and work shifts may change in accordance with department and business needs. title: Senior Network Operations Engineer
description: <h2>About the job</h2> <p>Turn complex network faults into lasting fixes, and make new services ready for reliable operation.</p> <p>As a Senior Network Operations Engineer in Bristol, UK, you’ll keep Graphcore’s networks reliable and secure. This full-time role spans the network lifecycle, from shaping operational requirements to resolving complex incidents.</p> <p>Your improvements will reduce downtime and manual errors across new and existing services. You’ll help colleagues operate services confidently, with practical runbooks and recovery procedures ready when problems arise.</p> <p>You’ll troubleshoot routing and firewalls, improve monitoring and automate routine operations. You’ll also support upgrades and deployments through testing, controlled changes and clear handovers.</p> <p>Your scope includes AWS networking, Cisco Software-Defined Access and SD-WAN across cloud and on-premises environments. Occasional travel to remote data centres and offices will involve installations, troubleshooting and hands-on support.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <h2>The team and culture</h2> <p>You’ll join a supportive, multidisciplinary IT infrastructure team that works closely together and regularly shares knowledge. With new projects ahead, you’ll bring operational experience into network designs alongside architects and project teams.</p> <p>As a senior escalation point, you’ll own complex incidents through to resolution. You’ll use monitoring evidence and recurring incident trends to prioritise reliability improvements.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <h2>What we’re looking for</h2> <p>AWS networking, Cisco Software-Defined Access (SDA) or SD-WAN experience would be particularly valuable, but is not essential.</p> <ul> <li>At least five years’ hands-on network engineering experience, focused on production support, with certification in a major networking platform.</li> <li>Strong practical knowledge of large-scale L2/L3 networks, including BGP, OSPF, switching, routing and resilience.</li> <li>Experience supporting centrally controlled Wi-Fi, such as Cisco Meraki or Aruba, and resolving connectivity and performance issues.</li> <li>Experience managing and troubleshooting centralised firewalls, including rulesets, NAT and VPNs, plus familiarity with open-source products such as pfSense.</li> <li>Hands-on use of Ansible, Python or similar tools to automate operations and manage network configurations.</li> <li>Evidence-led troubleshooting using monitoring, packet captures and logs, alongside clear communication, documentation and sound judgement during incidents.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></li> </ul> <p>While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Flexible working:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility</li> <li><strong>Generous leave:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work</li> <li><strong>Retirement planning support:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>Up to 5% matched pension</li> <li><strong>Phantom equity:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>Share in Graphcore’s success</li> <li><strong>Workplace experience:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day</li> <li><strong>Peace of mind protection:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones</li> <li><strong>Electric Vehicle Scheme:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice</li> <li><strong>Flexible benefits:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme and dental cover</li> </ul> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.</p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <h3>Sponsorship</h3> <p>Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <p><strong>Access to controlled technology</strong></p> <p>Some roles at Graphcore involve access to technology subject to U.S. export control regulations. Depending on the role, we may need to assess whether export authorisation is required, taking account of factors such as work location, citizenship and immigration status. Where authorisation is required, this may affect whether or when you can start the role. We’ll explain any relevant requirements during the recruitment process.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <h2>Join the Team at Graphcore</h2> <p>Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p>As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.</p> <p>Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <p>Apply to join Graphcore in Bristol and turn your network operations expertise into more reliable services.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 class="job-details__description-header text-color-secondary font-family-secondary" data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.employer-description-title'">About Us</h2> <div class="job-details__description-content basic-formatter" data-bind="html: pageData().job.corporateDescription"> <div>Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. </div> </div> <p> </p></div><h2 data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.organization-description-title'">About the Team</h2> <p>Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG) is seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team. This role will sit in either our Runtime/Compute or the Developer Experience/CICD squad.<br>As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will work across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, CI/CD systems, and internal developer tooling. You will work closely with Product Engineering, Security, Infrastructure IT, and other platform teams to build, enhance, and support our developer platform. You will help define standards and best practices, and act as a force multiplier for engineering teams by improving reliability, scalability, and developer productivity.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and deliver medium-to-large platform projects from implementation through    production</li> <li>Build and maintain internal platform services and tooling that improve developer experience and delivery velocity</li> <li>Partner with application teams to unblock delivery and align platform capabilities with developer needs</li> <li>Drive cloud cost efficiency and optimization across our cloud and infrastructure</li> <li>Improve operational excellence through observability, automation, and incident response</li> <li>Help evolve CI/CD pipelines and GitOps-based workflows</li> <li>Mentor junior engineers through code reviews and knowledge sharing</li> <li>Participate in on-call rotations and incident response</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>5–7 years of experience in platform, infrastructure, DevOps, or software engineering</li> <li>Proficiency with Python and Java. Familiarity with Kotlin, Go a plus</li> <li>Deep Kubernetes and container orchestration knowledge</li> <li>Proven CI/CD and GitOps experience</li> <li>Infrastructure as Code expertise (Terraform)</li> <li>Strong AWS and cloud-native experience</li> <li>Experience operating distributed, high-availability systems</li> <li>Strong ownership mindset and ability to deliver defined projects independently</li> <li>Clear communication and strong collaboration skills</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with internal developer platforms or tooling</li> <li>Exposure to regulated or high-availability environments</li> <li>Backend development experience (Java, Python, Go, or similar)</li> <li>Familiarity with observability and reliability engineering practices</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why Platform Engineering at FBG</strong></p> <p>Platform Engineering at FBG operates with a product-first mindset. Our mission is to empower developers with reliable, scalable, and intuitive platforms that accelerate innovation and delivery. </p> <p><strong>Working Across Regions</strong></p> <p>This role operates in a globally distributed environment, working closely with teams across the UK, Ireland, and the United States. Strong communication, time zone coordination, and shared ownership are essential for success.</p> <p><strong>Travel Expectations</strong></p> <p>Periodic travel to the United States is expected for offsites, planning sessions, and collaboration. Occasional travel within the UK and Ireland may also be required.</p> <p><strong>Not sure if you check every box?</strong></p> <p>We believe great engineers come from all kinds of backgrounds. We value <strong>impact, technical leadership, and a growth mindset</strong> just as much as specific tool experience.</p> <p>Unfortunately, we do not offer sponsorship and you do need to be living in the UK or Ireland to apply.</p> <p>Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our <a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></p> <p><em>Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it </em><a ----- <p></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Strategic Account Executive
description: <h2>About the Team</h2> <p>The Strategic Sales team at SevenRooms is on a mission to reshape the hospitality industry by helping the world’s leading hotel, restaurant and leisure groups own their guest relationships. We partner with multi-venue operators across EMEA as trusted advisors: we take a consultative approach, uncover gaps in how groups manage guest data, operations and distribution, and design solutions that reduce reliance on third-party networks and drive measurable revenue. Since SevenRooms joined DoorDash, we work alongside DoorDash and Deliveroo teams to bring merchants a connected offer across discovery, reservations, delivery and on-premise dining.</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We’re hiring an experienced Strategic Account Executive to uncover, drive and close new business with enterprise hospitality groups across EMEA. You will focus on hotel groups, multi-brand restaurant groups, and other large multi-venue operators (typically 50+ locations), selling the full SevenRooms platform: CRM and guest data, marketing automation, reservations and waitlist, table and revenue management, events and experiences, online ordering, Voice AI, and group reporting. These are complex, multi-stakeholder, multi-year deals, so you will navigate matrixed organisations, build executive-level relationships and structure commercial agreements that scale across venues and regions. You will work closely with Product, Solutions, Customer Success and Onboarding to make sure every enterprise partner launches successfully and grows with us.</p> <h2>You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Win new enterprise logos.</strong> Own a named-account strategy across hotel and restaurant groups with 50+ venues, building and running a pipeline through targeted outbound, partnerships, industry events and executive networks.</li> <li><strong>Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.</strong> Map decision-makers across operations, marketing, IT, finance, procurement and group leadership, and build consensus around a clear business case.</li> <li><strong>Sell a platform, not a point solution.</strong> Articulate how SevenRooms unifies guest data across venues to drive direct bookings, repeat visits, higher spend per cover and lower commission costs, and tailor the story to each group’s priorities.</li> <li><strong>Run the full sales lifecycle.</strong> Take deals from first conversation through discovery, executive presentations and live demos, commercial and financial deal structuring, RFP responses, security and legal review, contract negotiation and close.</li> <li><strong>Negotiate multi-year, multi-venue agreements.</strong> Structure pricing, rollout phasing and contract terms across brands, regions and entities.</li> <li><strong>Partner cross-functionally.</strong> Work with Solutions Consulting, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Onboarding, Customer Success and DoorDash and Deliveroo teams to shape rollout plans, integrations and long-term account growth.</li> <li><strong>Be a trusted advisor.</strong> Bring market insight, benchmarks and hospitality expertise to senior operators, and champion their success well beyond signature.</li> </ul> <h2>We’re excited about you because…</h2> <ul> <li>You have 8+ years of B2B enterprise SaaS sales experience with a consistent record of meeting and exceeding quota</li> <li>You have experience selling complex, multi-faceted platforms to mid-market and enterprise customers, ideally in hospitality, hotels, restaurants, leisure or adjacent verticals</li> <li>You have deep knowledge of, or strong relationships within, the hotel and hospitality industry</li> <li>You have experience building relationships with C-level and executive stakeholders and navigating large, matrixed organisations</li> <li>You have experience structuring and negotiating complex, multi-year deals, and managing RFPs, procurement and security reviews</li> title: Account Executive - AI Native, EMEA
description: About Us: AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal. Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now. Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp , Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale. We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation. Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g., Seaborn , Luigi ), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience. The Role: We’re hiring an Account Executive to win and grow Modal’s relationships with AI-native companies: the startups and scale-ups building their products on models from day one. These teams move fast, so our sales cycle does too. Deals often move forward from the very first call, and you’ll usually be talking directly with the founder or technical leader who owns the budget. You’ll own the full cycle, from sourcing to close to expansion, and you’ll partner closely with our founders, engineering, and product teams. You’ll also help build Modal’s presence in the developer community, because in this market, the best pipeline comes from engineers who already love the product. The ideal candidate has an engineering background, has worked as a solutions architect or in a similar technical role, and has since moved into selling. You’re as comfortable debugging a cold-start issue with an ML engineer as you are negotiating terms with a CEO. What You’ll Do: Own a book of AI-native accounts and close new business quickly, often moving from first call to signed deal in weeks rather than quarters. Sell directly to founders, CTOs, and heads of ML who define the ideal customer and hold the budget from day one. Get hands-on in technical conversations: scope workloads, set up quick proofs of concept, and show customers how Modal fits into their stack. Spot expansion early and help fast-growing customers scale their inference, training, and sandbox workloads as their usage takes off. Help build and engage Modal’s developer community through events, meetups, open-source channels, and word of mouth. Bring sharp, structured customer feedback to our product and engineering teams to shape the roadmap. Help define how Modal sells to AI-native companies, including the playbooks, pricing motions, and processes we’ll scale as the team grows. Requirements: An engineering background, followed by time as a solutions architect, sales engineer, or similar customer-facing technical role, and now experience as a closing seller. Current or recent experience at an AI-native company, ideally selling infrastructure, ML/AI, or developer tools. A track record of selling directly to founders and technical leaders and closing deals quickly in a high-velocity sales cycle. Experience building or engaging a developer community, or a clear point of view on how community drives pipeline. Enough technical depth to go deep on GPUs, inference, containers, and model training with engineers, without needing a sales engineer in the room. Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. Comfort in a fast-moving, early-stage environment and excitement about building processes from the ground up. Ability to work in person from our office 5 days a week. Compensation: $300K • Offers Equity • OTE $300K • Offers Equity Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Customer Service Team Leader
description: About Us Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. We run camera-based parking for landowners and operators, from hotels and colleges to shopping centres, across England, Scotland and Wales. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country. Role Overview We’re looking for a Customer Service Team Leader to lead our support team: six people across two desks, handling around 1,500 tickets a week. One desk helps the landowners and asset managers we work with; the other helps the drivers who park at their sites. Many tickets mean investigating across our systems, escalating to TechOps and following up until the problem is fixed. This is a people-leadership role first. You’ll set the standard, coach the team to hit it, and use the numbers to see what’s working and what isn’t. You’ll have the freedom to bring your own ideas, the backing of our COO, and Client Success, TechOps and Product teams to work with on them. And you’ll lead from the front, getting stuck into tickets with the team when it’s busy. Key Responsibilities Lead, coach and develop a team of six, with regular one-to-ones and clear standards for quality and output. Set targets for the team, hold people accountable to them, and help everyone get there. Keep response times, resolution and the backlog on track across both desks. Get stuck in on tickets when the queue is busy, and handle the trickier escalations yourself. Use the team’s numbers to spot what drivers and clients keep contacting us about, and work with other teams to fix the cause. Plan the rota, including Saturday cover, around leave and busy periods. Who we’re looking for You’ll need: Experience leading a customer service or support team (phone, email, chat or ticket-based) against KPIs. A track record of improving how a team performs. title: EMEA Account Executive - Emerging Enterprise - London
description: About CodeRabbit CodeRabbit is the governance and control layer for agentic software development, helping engineering teams trust the code they ship. AI can generate code faster than people can review and understand it. Teams still need to know whether each change solves the right problem, fits their architecture, and is safe to ship. We provide independent validation grounded in codebase context and team standards, giving people the evidence they need to judge what should ship. Across Review, Triage, Explain, and Secure, our platform challenges changes before merge, prioritizes pull requests by value, impact, and risk, explains what changed and why it matters, and monitors the codebase for security vulnerabilities after merge. CodeRabbit serves nearly 20,000 customers and supports approximately 300,000 open-source repositories, performing over 2 million code reviews each week. Our $143M Series C, raised at a $1.5B valuation, supports further product development and international expansion. Role Overview We’re looking for founding members of our Emerging Enterprise Account Executive Team in EMEA — sellers who thrive in high-growth environments and can open, develop, and close complex deals in technical markets. You’ll own a list of named prospects in markets across the EMEA region, drive outbound pipeline creation, close the initial deal, and continue to nurture and grow your accounts. This role requires ownership of the entire sales cycle as well as direct revenue responsibility for achieving and exceeding our sales goals. The role requires a deep technical understanding and curiosity to serve as a trusted advisor to prospective customers. What you will do: Own the full sales cycle: prospect, qualify, run PoVs, and close Drive outbound pipeline in named mid-enterprise accounts Deliver high-impact demos and articulate CodeRabbit’s value to both technical and business stakeholders Land and expand — grow usage and footprint across multiple teams Develop business value assessments and quantify ROI with customers Become a product expert and understand the CodeRabbit offering and ecosystem in depth Partner cross-functionally with marketing, product, and customer success to refine playbooks and GTM strategy What You’ll Bring 3+ years of full-cycle quota-carrying experience, preferably in a technical SaaS company Proven success generating outbound pipeline and closing six-figure deals in EMEA Experience selling to engineering leaders (CTOs, VPs Eng, DevOps, etc.) Strong technical curiosity and ability to learn complex products quickly Track record of multi-threaded deal management and value-based selling Excellent communication, organization, and ownership mindset Strong sense of ownership, self-motivation and eagerness to acquire new skills and solve new problems Bonus Points for: Fluent German language skills (written and spoken) Familiarity with AI, developer, and open source technologies Have experience in a Product Led Growth (PLG) company Our Values 🤝 Collaborative Humans: Prioritizing collective intelligence 🚀 Fearless Innovators: Turning obstacles into growth opportunities 💪 Persistent, Passionate Developers: Thriving on complex, long-term challenges 🎯 Impact-Driven Creators: Crafting intuitive tools for developers 🧠 Rapid Learners and Un-learners: Adapting quickly in our fast-paced technological world What We Offer Work on cutting-edge technology with real-world impact Collaborative and innovative environment Competitive salary, equity, and benefits Professional development opportunities To apply, please submit your resume. CodeRabbit is an equal opportunity employer, committed to diversity and inclusion. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Data Platform
description: About Evervault Evervault offers modular payments infrastructure for companies building their own payments stack. We keep raw card data off your systems, cut PCI compliance work, improve acceptance, mitigate fraud and chargebacks and decrease your cost of payments, so you keep full control. Trusted by Ramp, Rippling, Modern Treasury and Overwolf; Series B, led by Ribbit Capital. Role Overview You’ll be the first engineer dedicated to our data platform, and you’ll design and build it largely from scratch. You’ll own the platform that collects our event data, models it, and serves it to customers with roughly 15-second freshness, including building our time-series foundations. This is a senior, hands-on role: you’ll set the architecture, write most of the code and set the bar for the data team that grows around you. You’ll work closely with our VP of Engineering, Product and our leadership team. Product decides which data products to build; you own how they’re built and what the data can support. What You’ll Be Doing Designing and building real-time ingestion for three sources: events our platform already emits, new instrumentation in our product, and data our customers send us Rebuilding our event streaming layer, with the authority to choose how Modelling structured and time-series data in ClickHouse and Databricks so aggregations, trends and benchmarks are fast and cheap at scale (our current defaults, though you can make the case for change) Designing the external data contracts and APIs customers build on, including versioning, reliability and isolation of each customer’s data Defining the event contracts our product engineers instrument against Owning the platform in production: monitoring, data quality, cost and on-call for the systems you build Your First Year In your first few months you’ll assess what we have, decide the platform architecture, and scope our first data product with Product and Engineering. After that, you’ll rebuild the streaming layer and ship the first external product on the new platform, most likely aggregated analytics or direct data access for customers. Later in the year you’ll help us hire a domain expert who decides which signals and benchmarks are worth building. Machine learning is out of scope for now; it comes once we have enough clean historical data. Requirements Production experience building real-time or near-real-time ingestion with event streaming, such as Kafka, Kinesis or Redpanda Deep experience with ClickHouse or a similar analytical database, including modelling time-series data for fast aggregation at volume A track record of shipping an external, multi-tenant data product or data API that customers depended on (internal reporting pipelines alone won’t cover this) Experience migrating a messy live system to a new one without downtime or data loss Senior-level engineering habits: system design, testing, and running the services you build in production Sound judgement working independently: you’ll be our most senior data voice, and we’ll rely on your technical calls A product mindset: you won’t work directly with customers, but you’ll often be the person who knows what the data can and can’t support Nice to Have Experience in payments or with sensitive, regulated data Databricks or Spark experience alongside ClickHouse Experience as an early or founding member of a data team, including hiring This Might Not Be for You If… You’re mainly an analyst, BI or data science specialist: this role builds the platform and the external products on it Your experience is mostly dashboards, internal reporting pipelines or modelling for analysis You want a hands-off architect role: you’ll write most of the code You want to work fully remotely: we’re in our Shoreditch office Tuesday to Thursday Compensation, Benefits & Why Join Competitive salary Stock options with an extended exercise window Private health insurance Unlimited PTO & flexible working hours Daily lunch budget Build a company’s data platform from the first line of code, with the authority to make the big architectural calls and work directly with C-Level Interview Process Recruiter Screen Hiring Manager Interview Technical Interview System Design Interview Final with our Founder References and Offer Location This role is based in London, in our Shoreditch office Tuesday to Thursday. We do not currently sponsor UK work visas. Candidates must be based in the location specified. Any applications from candidates not in the required location may not receive a response. title: Senior Underwriter
description: About Ryft Ryft is a regulated payment facilitator and authorised payment institution building the infrastructure layer for modern commerce platforms. We enable marketplaces, SaaS platforms and multi-party ecosystems to embed and monetise payments natively. Our technology handles onboarding, compliance, orchestration, split payments and revenue sharing, allowing our partners to focus on growth while we manage complexity. We are now entering the next phase of scale, expanding into new verticals and building a category-defining embedded payments platform. About the role We are looking for an experienced Senior Underwriter to join our Underwriting team. As a Payment Facilitator, we onboard and oversee our merchants directly. You will assess and onboard a varied portfolio of these merchants, with a focus on marketplaces and platforms. You will own complex underwriting cases from start to finish. This includes reviewing ownership structures and financial health, setting risk exposure limits, and making clear recommendations that protect the business while helping our merchants grow. This is a senior position. You will be expected to use sound independent judgement, guide less experienced colleagues, and help improve our underwriting policies, procedures and tools. Key responsibilities - Lead the end-to-end underwriting and onboarding of merchants, including complex cases, ensuring decisions follow internal risk appetite, regulatory requirements and card scheme rules. - Underwrite marketplaces and platforms, assessing the business model, flow of funds and customer journey. - Onboard merchants with complex organisational structures, including multi-layered ownership, group entities and cross-border structures, identifying ultimate beneficial owners and controllers. - Screen merchants, directors, UBOs and connected parties for PEP status, sanctions and adverse media using screening tools, and assess and escalate potential matches appropriately. - Review merchant websites using third-party website monitoring providers to identify content violations, prohibited or restricted products and services, missing or inadequate terms and conditions, refund and privacy policies, and inconsistencies with the declared business model. - Carry out credit risk analysis on merchants by reviewing financial statements, management accounts and bank statements to evaluate liquidity, profitability, solvency and trading patterns. - Assess financial exposure, including chargeback, refund and delivery risk (e.g., future delivery and prepayment models), and recommend suitable mitigants. - Write clear, well-reasoned underwriting summaries and recommendations for approval, setting out key risks, mitigants and the rationale behind each decision. - Conduct periodic reviews and re-underwriting of existing merchants, monitoring changes in risk profile, processing behaviour and financial standing. - Work with Sales, Risk, Compliance and other teams to give timely, commercially aware risk decisions. - Coach and support junior underwriters, reviewing their cases and sharing knowledge across the team. Requirements Essential: - Extensive experience in merchant underwriting, merchant onboarding and credit risk within payments, acquiring, a payment service provider or a related financial services environment. - Strong knowledge of KYB/KYC, AML and CTF requirements as they apply to merchant onboarding. - Hands-on experience with PEP, sanctions and adverse media screening tools, and with investigating and resolving potential matches. - Experience onboarding businesses with complex ownership and organisational structures, and identifying UBOs. - The ability to perform in-depth credit risk analysis, including interpreting financial statements and bank statements and assessing a merchant's financial strength and risk exposure. - Sound judgement and the confidence to make and defend risk decisions while balancing commercial objectives. - Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage several complex cases at once. - Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to produce concise, well-structured risk summaries and recommendations. - Fluent written and spoken English. Desirable: - Experience with higher-risk sectors such as travel, CBD or charities. - Knowledge of card scheme risk programmes (e.g., VAMP, MATCH, BRAM) and reserve setting. - Familiarity with tools such as Dotfile, HubSpot, G2, Endole. title: Machine Learning Researcher
description: Company Neuphonic is building the future of on-device voice AI. We develop ultra-low-latency voice models that enable super-realistic, human-like speech directly on devices. Our focus is on building efficient generative audio models and infrastructure that can run on CPU-constrained hardware, enabling real-time voice interaction without relying on large cloud infrastructure. By dramatically reducing latency and compute requirements, we're making natural conversational AI possible on phones, embedded devices, browsers, and edge systems. title: Senior Partner Account Executive, UK - Insurance
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the Role: We are looking for a strategic and results-driven Senior Partner Account Executive to launch, scale, and optimise partnerships across our ecosystem with a focus on insurance carriers and brokers. Samsara's telematics and dashcam technology already help thousands of customers improve safety and reduce risk - this role will accelerate those benefits by developing high-impact partnerships that drive mutual growth. You will be the face of Samsara to insurance executives, building scalable programmes that directly influence customer acquisition, retention, and loss cost improvement. If you thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, are motivated by measurable business impact, and enjoy turning ideas into reality, this is your opportunity to make a difference. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. In this role you will: Own and grow our relationships with insurance carriers, brokers and MGAs in the UK Design and run partner programmes that drive customer acquisition, retention and loss-cost improvement - and the Samsara revenue that comes with them Map accounts with partners, pick joint targets and bring Samsara sales into the deals Build the playbook: how we qualify, onboard and scale insurance partnerships You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact - helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your partners are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live. Samsara's top employees do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline. You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. You want to develop the playbook, not just follow one: Our partner ecosystem is young. You'll define how we take partners to value - from first conversation to joint customers - and build the model that lets those partnerships deliver maximum value for Samsara at scale. You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. You build genuine relationships with your partners and our customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. Minimum requirements for the role: Strong sales, partnerships, or business development experience, ideally within a B2B technology or insurance-related field and a track record of overachievement. A builder mentality - you thrive in ambiguous environments and know how to create structure, process, and scale. Exceptional relationship management skills, with experience engaging stakeholders from the C-suite to front-line sales teams. A strategic and data-driven mindset, using insights to optimise programmes and drive revenue. Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple initiatives simultaneously. An ideal candidate also has: Experience working in or with insurance carriers, brokers, or related financial services. Consulting experience, ideally working with insurance companies. Why Join Samsara? Make an impact: Your work will directly improve safety, efficiency, and sustainability in industries that power the global economy. Work with the best: Join a high-performance, mission-driven team that values collaboration, innovation, and results. Grow with us: We're scaling rapidly, which means new challenges, learning opportunities, and career advancement. Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. Belonging at Samsara At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. Accommodations Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. Our Commitment to Authenticity We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. Fraudulent Employment Offers Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here . title: Deployment Strategist - SAP & ERP Specialist
description: TL;DR You know how to walk into an enterprise, spot the pain points in its ERP processes, and see what good could look like. At Conduct you turn that into a game changing moment: you show leadership, with confidence, how Conduct will transform the way they run SAP. You own optimising the delivery of transformation projects with Conduct, from the first use case to adoption across the business. You build the trust that turns a pilot into a long-term partnership, and the product insights you bring back directly shape what we build next. Why Conduct The world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the systems they run on. Today they don't, and you've seen why firsthand. Every new product line, pricing change or process redesign runs into SAP estates layered with decades of custom code, user exits and enhancements no single person fully understands. Requirements take months to ship. S/4HANA migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain, and the 2027 ECC deadline is forcing every large enterprise to face it. We're building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems. We've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service. We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world's largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out. What you'll own You will make sure Conduct lands and sticks inside our most strategic SAP customers. You join accounts early, shape how Conduct fits into their transformation programmes, and fully take over post-sale. You'll have a direct line from what you see in the field to what ships in the product. Be the SAP brain in the room. Translate between CIOs, process owners, Basis teams and our engineers. Scope use cases across finance, supply chain, procurement and sales that land real value fast. Design the transformation. Get under the skin of complex, heavily customised ECC and S/4HANA landscapes. Conceptualise where Conduct can have the biggest impact, then lead the deployment that gets the customer there. Turn pilots into partnerships. Onboard hundreds of end users, prove ROI, spot expansion signals and hold the early commercial conversations that grow an account. Shape the product. You'll have a direct line into product and engineering. Your view of how SAP actually runs in the real world will shape our roadmap. Build the engine. Our GTM team is small and lean. You'll build the onboarding flows, tooling and reusable playbooks that let customer capacity compound without headcount growing linearly. Work with our SI partners. You speak their language. Help partners deploy Conduct inside their own programmes. No two days look the same. You'll fly out to customers when it counts and spend the rest of the time building alongside the team. Who we hire We're looking for people obsessed with delivering for customers. You'll fit right in if former colleagues would, without hesitating, call you one of the sharpest people they've worked with. In practice that tends to look like: 3+ years in SAP or ERP consulting , at a Big Four firm, a global SI or a specialist SAP partner. You've been on live implementations, rollouts or S/4HANA transformations, not just advisory. Real depth in at least one area of SAP. Functional (FI/CO, SD, MM, PP, EWM), technical (ABAP, integration, BTP) or solution architecture. You understand how processes and custom code fit together across the landscape. Client-facing confidence. You've run workshops, owned a workstream and earned the trust of senior stakeholders who were sceptical at first. Commercial instinct. You notice the next problem worth solving, and you understand that a great deployment is how accounts grow. Builder energy. You want to do the hands-on customer work and build the process behind it. Ambiguity excites you more than it worries you. Curiosity about AI. You don't need to be an engineer. You do need to want to learn how it works and where it breaks. Low ego, high self-awareness. You're comfortable saying "I don't know" in a complex technical room, then going and figuring it out. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We care more about trajectory and sharpness than a perfect match. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: About the role This is a permanent, part-time role, working two days a week. Unity is a scaling business with strong reward foundations already in place. We now need a senior reward specialist to strengthen them, fill the gaps and shape them into a framework that grows with the firm. We want reward that reflects how Unity actually works: Partner-led client teams, Functional Leader-led enablement teams, and a culture built on trust, direct feedback and progress over process. We don’t want a generic framework lifted from a larger, more traditional firm. You’ll take what we have, judge what’s working and what isn’t, and build it out where it needs to go next. You’ll also run it: pay reviews, benefits renewals, and the data and reporting that keep it trusted. You’ll refine it each cycle and make sure the framework is well documented and easy for others to work with. It suits someone who gets energy from building and improving, and who knows that reward only proves itself once it’s live. You’ll be comfortable with ambiguity and confident making judgement calls. You’ll respect what’s already been done while being willing to challenge it. You’ll also take satisfaction in the steady work of keeping a system accurate, fair and well-run. This is a role where one expert can own reward end to end, without needing a full-time seat. It will suit an experienced reward specialist who wants a senior, high-impact role with a bounded commitment, including people with a fractional or portfolio background who now want a permanent home. What you’ll own Reward strategy and philosophy: build on and evolve Unity’s approach to pay. That covers how we position against the market, how pay works across client-facing and enablement tracks, and how reward reinforces Unity’s “progress over process” culture rather than working against it. Pay structure and benchmarking: develop and maintain salary bands and grading across roles and levels, benchmarked against relevant professional services and advisory market data. Pay review cycles: design and run the annual (or biannual) pay and bonus review. That includes timelines, guidance for Partners and Functional Leaders, calibration support, and sign-off with the Management Team / Partners Group. Benefits: own the benefits offering end to end, including provider relationships, renewals, flexible benefits design and clear communication of value to employees. Pay equity and compliance: run regular pay equity analysis (including gender pay gap reporting where applicable), keep Unity compliant with UK reward-related employment law, and flag risk to the CPO early. Reward governance and data: keep reward data accurate and current in our people systems, and produce clear reporting for the Management Team on pay spend, equity and market position. Advisory support: partner directly with Partners and Functional Leaders on individual pay decisions, such as new hire offers, promotions and retention cases. Your recommendations will be clear, defensible and grounded in the framework, not one-off improvisation. The future of reward at Unity: work with the CPO to shape how reward evolves as the firm grows, including the capability, capacity and structure we’ll need over time. What success looks like in your first 12 months A refined, published pay and grading framework that Partners and Functional Leaders trust and actually use A clean, well-governed annual pay review with no surprises for the Management Team Reward decisions that are consistent, benchmarked and easy to explain, in keeping with Unity’s “trust and accountability” and “no surprises” principles Reward documented and embedded, so that the framework is understood, easy to work with and keeps improving with each cycle What we’re looking for Senior reward / compensation and benefits experience, ideally including time in professional services, consulting or another partnership-style environment Equally at home developing and extending an existing framework and running it well day to day, from benchmarking data and banding mechanics to benefits contracts and review timelines Someone who sees the operational side of reward as part of the craft. Each pay cycle, renewal and equity report is a chance to test and improve the framework. A pragmatic operator who can deliver across the full scope of reward in two focused days a week, prioritising the highest-leverage work first Confident advising Partners and senior leaders directly, with recommendations grounded in evidence rather than precedent alone Comfortable working with light process and high trust, building just enough structure and no more Experience of part-time, interim or fractional working is welcome, but not required. We value people who can make an impact quickly and build things that last. How this role fits at Unity You’ll sit in the People Team, working closely with the Chief People Officer, the Performance Lead (a fellow part-time specialist), People Ops, and Partners and Functional Leaders across the business. Reward decisions at Unity draw on the same “collective insight, direct feedback” approach that runs through how the firm manages performance and probation.
